question: With the BZ0 scorer, split, explicit operator and FedPAIE objective unchanged, does hard restriction to the scorer's exact trusted-support bank make per-source selection safe and materially outperform the K=1 fixed trusted operator?

only_change.source_specific_selector: hard argmin with candidate-index tie break

comparators.fixed_k1: fit-target-selected fixed trusted-support candidate from BZ0
comparators.proxy_only: same trusted bank without fidelity or gap
comparators.oracle: per-source hidden-target argmax within the trusted bank, diagnostic only

branch_rules.oracle_gap_fails: retain the fixed K=1 trusted operator because the bank has insufficient per-source routing value
branch_rules.primary_fails: retain fixed K=1; the frozen scorer does not earn routing even inside support, and no scorer/candidate/weight/gate rescue is allowed
branch_rules.passes: retain trusted-support hard selection only as a digital-retouch development candidate; require disjoint confirmation before visual or product consideration

forbidden: change the BZ0 scorer, features, Ridge alpha, split or paper coefficients
add candidates, refit candidates or project broad-bank candidates into support
use validation or hidden targets in source-specific selection
tune a router after hidden results
claim film, stock, preference, calibration or product evidence
claim_ceiling: FiveK digital-retouch K=1-versus-trusted-support hard-selection evidence for bounded explicit parameters only; not film, stock, preference, calibration or product evidence
